title: Lala's full name and other Johnny Lalas around town
summary: The interviewers ask for his full name for the record and note that several Johnny Lalas played music in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Well, I was wondering, speaking of names, like your father's name, what is your full name? We might be nice to have it here on the record. My full name? Johnny Lowe. And the middle name? I had it. N is my middle name, but I never used it. In case there would be any confusion, I thought it would be good to have it in the middle. Yeah, Johnny Lowe.
Well, there was several Johnny Lowe's around town.
Yeah, but there were a few playing music.
Yes. Yeah. We'd take plenty of mics. Yeah. Plenty of mics, yeah.
And they all play, I guess. Everyone.
